RULES AS OF JULY 2026

General information, not advice

Portugal Life Compass — this website, our YouTube channel and every piece of content we publish — provides general information about living in, moving to and understanding Portugal. Nothing here is tax advice, legal advice, immigration advice, investment advice or financial advice, and nothing here creates any professional–client relationship. Before making decisions, confirm your own situation with a qualified professional (a lawyer, a certified accountant / contabilista certificado, or an immigration specialist) or with the competent Portuguese authority.

How our information is verified

Every legal or tax statement we publish is checked against official sources — the consolidated legislation of the Diário da República, the Portal das Finanças, official government portals such as AIMA and Segurança Social, and EUR-Lex for EU law. Where a claim could not be verified in those sources, we omit it or state that it is unverified.

Rules change — check the date

Portuguese tax and immigration rules change frequently, often with each year's State Budget. Every page and video carries a reference date ("Rules as of [month/year]"). Content is accurate to the best of our verification as of that date; it may be out of date by the time you read or watch it. The examples and figures we use are illustrative, not personal calculations.

Errors and corrections

Despite our verification process, errors are possible. If you spot one, tell us in the comments on the relevant video — corrections are made visibly.

How this content is produced

Portugal Life Compass is produced with the help of AI tools — narration, visuals and editing. Every legal and tax statement is verified against the official sources named above before it is published, and the verification is done by a human-supervised process, not by the AI on its own. Our videos carry YouTube's altered-or-synthetic-content disclosure, and our TikTok and Instagram posts carry those platforms' AI-content labels.

Third-party links and monetization

Links to third-party websites (including YouTube and file-hosting services) are provided for convenience; we don't control their content or their privacy practices. This website currently contains no sponsored content and no affiliate links. If that changes, any affiliate link or sponsorship will be clearly disclosed where it appears.
